name: Broad-tailed Hummingbird
desc: Broad-tailed Hummingbird (Selasphorus platycercus): hunts or scavenges other animals. Recorded 414 times near the park in GBIF.
about: The broad-tailed hummingbird is a medium-sized hummingbird species found in highland regions from western United States and Western Canada to Mexico and Guatemala.
